text.tspan: Recommendation: 19 servers with 4× NVIDIA B300 SXM each serve 300 users with requests of up to
128k tokens (≈ 98,000 words ≈ 200 pages; 64k on average): ≈ 16 users per server. Each server
runs its own copy of the model, and a load balancer (a router in front of the servers) spreads
the users across them. Caution: each server runs at 95% of its guaranteed capacity, so waits
grow fast with more traffic: one more server leaves headroom.
Alternative: 14 servers with 8× NVIDIA B200 SXM each (≈ 23 users per server). Caution: each server
runs at 92% of its guaranteed capacity, so waits grow fast with more traffic: one more server
Not enough: RTX PRO 6000 Server, L4, L40S, A100 and H100, even with 8 GPUs in one server; RTX
A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, RTX PRO 6000 WS, RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q and consumer cards, even with 4;
Speed for each user: writing about 29 words per second (16 to 43; 39 tokens/s); with everyone busy
the first words appear after about 1.9 s, and a full 128k-token request alone is read in about
Confidence: memory high (±3.9%); writing speed medium (±45%); reading time low, not precise enough
to decide (more than ±50%); user count medium (±45%). Plan on the guaranteed figures.
